title: kithd: bind listener only to tailnet IPs
description: Create kithd::listener module. bind_tailnet_listeners(ts: &LocalApiClient, port: u16) -> Result<Vec<TcpListener>, ListenerError>: call ts.status().await, extract tailscale_ips; if Status fails return TailscaleUnavailable; if empty return NoTailnetIps; for each IP parse as IpAddr (log warning + skip on parse error), bind TcpListener to (ip, port) (log warning + continue on bind error); if no listeners bound return AllBindsFailed; log each successful bind at INFO. ListenerError enum: TailscaleUnavailable(AuthError), NoTailnetIps, AllBindsFailed. Never bind to 0.0.0.0 or ::. pub mod listener added to lib.rs.
